meta.name: JSON Outline Schema
meta.about: JSON Outline Schema in parts, generated from the json-outline-schema repo's three schema files: the core outline and items, the HAXcms site.json conventions layered on top, and the skeleton format, with everything that reads or writes it.

js_core.desc: Core JSON Outline Schema (JOS): a work (outline) and a flat list of items whose tree is expressed through `parent` + `order`. This schema is intentionally lenient about legacy value types (numeric strings for `indent`/`order`) because real HAXcms data contains both; writers SHOULD emit the canonical form described in each property. Rules that JSON Schema cannot express (unique ids, parent references, cycles, unique slugs) are enforced by scripts/validate.js.

js_site.desc: A HAXcms site manifest (site.json): core JSON Outline Schema plus the metadata conventions HAXcms reads and writes. Unknown keys inside `metadata.*` groups are allowed (HAXcms passes them through), but unknown top-level keys on items are rejected because HAXcms drops them on save.

js_skel.desc: A reusable starter for new HAXcms sites, served by the `skeletonsList` / `getSkeleton` endpoints and written by the HAXcms site-skeleton-generator. `build.items` is an extended JSON Outline Schema item list: same tree fields, no `location`, plus an inline `content` HTML string.

jp_outline.desc: The work itself: id, title, author, description, license and metadata.

jp_items.desc: A flat list of items. The tree is expressed through parent and order, so moving a page never rewrites the pages around it.

jp_itemmeta.desc: What HAXcms keeps per page: published, hideInMenu, locked, created, updated, tags, pageType, relatedItems, icon, image, theme, readtime, images, videos, files, contentDetails, overridePathauto, plugins.

jp_skelbuild.desc: A skeleton's items carry their page content inline, so one file is a whole starter site.

ji_id.desc: Unique id of the item within this outline. HAXcms uses `item-<uuid v4>`; skeletons use bare UUIDs. Treat as opaque.

ji_title.desc: Title to display for this item.

ji_description.desc: Short description of the item (HAXcms auto-fills this from the first text of the page).

ji_parent.desc: `id` of the parent item, or `null` for a top-level item. `null` is canonical; an empty string is accepted only as a legacy form for reading older data and should not be written.

ji_order.desc: Sort weight relative to siblings that share the same `parent`. Canonical form: 0-based integer, contiguous within a sibling group.

ji_indent.desc: Visual indentation level (integer, 0 = top level). In a typical outline it equals the item's depth in the tree. It MAY intentionally differ when an outline wants a different presentation than its hierarchy (for example, sibling pages displayed at different indents), but that is rare. Consumers MUST derive hierarchy from `parent`, never from `indent`.

ji_location.desc: Relative path to the resource holding this item's content. HAXcms convention: `pages/<id>/index.html`.

ji_slug.desc: URL path segment(s) for this item, relative to the site base. May contain `/` (HAXcms with pathauto builds `parent-slug/child-slug`). Must be unique within the outline. Must not start with `/`.

jm_author.desc: Site author profile shown by themes.

jm_site.desc: Site-level site settings. Fields: name, logo, lang, domain, homePageId, tags, created, updated, version, git, static, settings.

jm_theme.desc: Site-level theme settings. Fields: element, path, name, thumbnail, styleGuide, variables, regions.

jm_platform.desc: Site-level platform settings. Fields: audience, features, allowedBlocks, delete, blocks.

jm_build.desc: How the site was originally created (written once by HAXcms at creation time).

tours.label: Inside site.json
tours.message: The core outline, the HAXcms layer on top, and the skeleton format, generated from the three schema files.

scenes.caption: Three schema files: the core, the HAXcms site.json layer, and skeletons.
The core is an outline and a flat list of items.
Each item: id, parent and order for the tree, slug for the URL, location for the page file.
HAXcms adds site, theme, platform, build and plugin metadata.
The outline designer, the CLI, HAX11ty, importers and themes all read or write it.
